# Audit Report

## Objective restated

Fix MEDIUM finding: CHANGELOG 0.113.2 documented the BAD_AUTHORS pre-push scan as `git log --first-parent`, but the shipped hook (`PRE_PUSH_HOOK` in src/main.rs) actually uses `git rev-list --not --remotes` / `--not $remote_sha` + per-commit `git log -1` with no `--first-parent` — the changelog described an implementation that never shipped.

## Findings

**1. The false shipped-impl claim is gone; the entry now matches the code verbatim.** The commit diff (cf65d76, +24/−16, CHANGELOG.md only) removes `git log --first-parent --format='%ae%n%ce' "$RANGE"` and replaces it with the actual implementation: `git rev-list "$local_sha" --not "$remote_sha"` for existing-ref updates and `git rev-list "$local_sha" --not --remotes"` for new-ref pushes, with per-commit `git log -1 --format='%ae%n%ce'`. This matches the executable hook code at main.rs:2517–2523 exactly, including the lowercase variable names. The remaining "first-parent" mentions in the CHANGELOG are only the explicit "CORRECTED 2026-08-09" disclaimer and historical narrative — no claim that it shipped. The behavior difference the finding called out is now documented (side-merge identities excluded via `--not` already-published exclusion, not first-parent filtering), and the pre-fix narrative (tag push with `remote_sha=0` scanned entire history) is preserved accurately, consistent with the hook's own comment block.

**2. Hook cross-check confirms no `--first-parent` flag ships.** Grep of the full `PRE_PUSH_HOOK` region shows `first-parent` only in comment lines (narrative), while all executable scan lines use `git rev-list ... --not ...`. The old entry's claim is verifiably false in the code and verifiably removed from the changelog.

**3. Regression test is real and passes.** `pre_push_hook_test_identity_on_non_first_parent_merge_passes` exists at src/tests.rs:406, builds a real `--no-ff` side-merge with test@test authors, models already-published commits via a remote-tracking branch, and pushes an annotated tag. Ran it: 1 passed. Full `pre_push` suite: 7 passed, 0 failed.

**4. Contract satisfied.** Commit cf65d76 is on branch main (HEAD), authored by DraconDev <dracsharp@gmail.com>, which equals the repo's configured `user.name`/`user.email`; working tree clean. findings.md line 7 is checked `- [x] … — fixed in cf65d76`.

**Non-blocking observation (out of finding scope):** the doc comment above the regression test (src/tests.rs:397–399) still says "the BAD_AUTHORS scan must use `--first-parent`" — a stale comment describing the never-shipped design intent. It is not part of the finding (which scopes CHANGELOG vs src/main.rs), does not appear in the changelog, and does not affect test validity — the test passes against the shipped `--not` implementation. Not a blocker.
